Now that you've completed the course, let's discuss some other upskilling opportunities we have available for students and working professionals in the U.S. and U.S. Affiliated Pacific.

## Short-Course Certifications

Every semester, we'll offer different short-course certifications on topics relevant to emerging technologies. They follow the same format - 6 weeks and completely online. Here is our tentative short-course portfolio for the following year:

*Spring 2027*

- GIS Fundamentals
- SDG Analytics in R
- Agentic AI For Security & Resilience

*Summer 2027*

- GIS Advanced
- Blockhain, Zero Trust and Cybersecurity

*Fall 2027*

- VITA-AI: Virtue Innovation Technology and Agency in AI
- Decision Science

::: {.task-item}
**Sign up for a short-course** - Register using this [link](https://tinyurl.com/cuh-dataskills). If you have any questions about a specific course, send an email to victoria.delacruz@chaminade.edu
:::

## TechSkills Program

TechSkills is an online training program that provides a first look into the world of data science, AI, and cyberinfrastructure. It leverages [DataCamp](https://www.datacamp.com/?utm_cid=1565610606&utm_aid=144928624250&utm_campaign=220808_1-ps-brd~brd~branded-pure_2-b2c_3-nam_4-rtw_5-na_6-na_7-le_8-pdsh-go_9-b-e_10-na_11-na&utm_loc=9032810-&utm_mtd=e-c&utm_kw=datacamp&utm_source=google&utm_medium=paid_search&utm_content=ps-other~nam-en~brd~pure~pure&gad_source=1&gad_campaignid=1565610606&gbraid=0AAAAADQ9WsFSfyi3nNNe-V9cpkGOCsTZQ&gclid=CjwKCAiAqabXBhBUEiwAw_SQpfGF90AE4W-ey9ZF5Z-OyzjX4GY7B9qXjrje6G5Vs-iq6w9zDnRveRoCiLEQAvD_BwE), a data & AI upskilling platform.

There are four tracks you can complete through TechSkills:

- Data Science
- AI
- Cyberinfrastructure
- Power BI

Once you complete the tracks, you'll earn a National Science Foundation/United Nations CIFAL Certificate of Complete and DataCamp credentials. Both can be uploaded to your LinkedIn!

We have the Fundamentals and Advanced programs. You are eligible for a track on the Advanced program upon completion of the same track from the Fundamentals program.

TechSkills is free for students and working professionals in the U.S. and U.S. Affiliated Pacific. Participants can be accepted on a rolling basis. 

::: {.task-item}
**Sign up for TechSkills** - Register using this [link](https://tinyurl.com/cuh-techskills). If you do register, send an email to victoria.delacruz@chaminade.edu so we can get you started with the program. 

:::
